newsitem.title: USA: Ziegler stake lifted by New West Investors.
newsitem.headline: Ziegler stake lifted by New West Investors.

text.p: A group including New West Investors L.P. said Tuesday it had raised its stake in Ziegler Cos Inc to 183,500 common shares, or 7.5 percent, from 6.4 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included the purchase of 6,600 shares between November 12 and January 16 at prices ranging from $16.875 to $18.375 per share.
New West holds the stake for investment.
Ziegler is a financial services holding company based in West Bend, Wis.
